title: Old Optimizer, New Norm: An Anthology
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Recasts Adam/Shampoo/Muon as steepest descent under different norms; each parameter type gets its own norm. This IS the MILO 'structure-aligned' principle stated as theory.

title: Modular Duality in Deep Learning
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Prescribes the correct 'dualizer' (update map) for each layer type — RMS→RMS for embeddings, spectral for hidden. Directly prescribes what MION's embedding path should be.

title: Scalable Optimization in the Modular Norm
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Assigns each module a norm, normalizes updates to it; gives width/depth LR transfer for free (Modula). Frames the single-LR claim rigorously and gives a muP-like transfer story.

title: Training Deep Learning Models with Norm-Constrained LMOs (Scion)
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Linear-minimization-oracle optimizers over norm balls; unifies Muon-like methods and gives scaling/transfer. A unified frame to cite for the family.

title: Training Neural Networks at Any Scale
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Recent synthesis of norm-based/scalable optimizer design; useful related-work anchor.

title: Muon is Scalable for LLM Training (Moonlight)
thread: Muon at scale + weight decay + RMS match
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Shows Muon needs weight decay + per-param update-RMS matching to scale; 16B MoE. Their update-scale matching is exactly MION's RMS-unit rescale — strong citation for §2.3.

title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence (MuonClip)
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Largest public Muon run (1T MoE); introduces MuonClip to fix attention-logit blowups. Evidence Muon-family scales; a stability lever MION may need at scale.

title: NorMuon: Making Muon more efficient and scalable
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Adds a per-neuron (row) second-moment normalization ON TOP of orthogonalization. This is precisely the MiloM per-row idea fused with MION's spectral path — the most direct 'synchronize' candidate.

title: Dion: Distributed Orthonormalized Updates
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Scalable orthonormal updates via distributed/amortized orthogonalization; addresses the 'no distributed results' limitation and cheaper NS at scale.

title: PolarGrad: Matrix-Gradient Optimizers from a Unifying Preconditioning View
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Polar-decomposition family unifying Muon/Shampoo as matrix-gradient preconditioners; another frame to position the spectral path.

title: AMO: Adaptive Muon Orthogonalization
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Makes the degree of orthogonalization adaptive — bridges 'full orthogonalization (MION) vs gentle group-std (MILO)'; relevant to the regime finding.

title: How Much Orthogonalization Does Muon Need?
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Studies partial orthogonalization; supports a gated/tunable-strength spectral update for the pretraining↔fine-tuning spectrum.

title: Preconditioning Benefits of Spectral Orthogonalization in Muon
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Theoretical account of when spectral orthogonalization preconditions well — supports the ablation showing the spectral path is essential.

title: The Polar Express: Optimal Matrix Sign Methods for Muon
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Optimal odd-polynomial iteration for the matrix sign/orthogonalization — faster/more accurate than the quintic NS MION uses; drop-in improvement to ns_steps cost.

title: Accelerating Newton-Schulz via Chebyshev-type Polynomials
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Chebyshev-type acceleration of the NS iteration; another lever on MION's ~20% per-step overhead.

title: Iterative Orthogonalization Scaling Laws
relevance_to_MILO_MION: How many NS steps are needed as matrices grow — informs the ns_steps ablation at larger scale.

title: Feature Learning in Infinite-Width Networks (muP / Tensor Programs)
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Original maximal-update parametrization enabling zero-shot LR transfer across width. The backbone for the requested scaling-law/LR-transfer experiment.

title: u-muP: The Unit-Scaled Maximal Update Parametrization
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Cleaner, more robust muP variant; recommended parameterization for MION's transfer study given its RMS-unit design already.

title: On the Width Scaling of Neural Optimizers Under Matrix Operator Norms
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Width-scaling / LR-transfer theory specifically for operator-norm (Muon-like) optimizers — the exact tool to give MION a muP-style single-LR-transfers claim.

title: Adam-mini: Use Fewer Learning Rates To Gain More
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Baseline already in the paper; block-wise single LR. Position MION's single-buffer against it directly.

title: SWAN: SGD with Normalization and Whitening Enables Stateless Training
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Stateless optimizer via gradient normalization + whitening — conceptually the closest published relative of MILO's group-standardization; must-cite for related work.

title: APOLLO: SGD-like Memory, AdamW-level Performance
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Structured low-rank scaling for Adam-like performance at SGD memory — competing point on the accuracy/memory frontier MION claims.

title: GaLore: Memory-Efficient LLM Training by Gradient Low-Rank Projection
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Low-rank projection of gradients; another frontier competitor and a mechanism relevant to low-rank orthogonalization for FT.

title: Controlling Text-to-Image Diffusion by Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT)
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Fine-tunes via orthogonal transforms that PRESERVE pairwise angles/hyperspherical energy — the principled 'orthogonality that helps FT'. Reframes MION's FT failure as wrong kind of orthogonality.

title: LoRA-Muon: Spectral Steepest Descent on the Low-Rank Manifold
thread: Muon spectral update on low-rank FT
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Applies Muon-style spectral steepest descent restricted to a low-rank manifold — directly the 'low-rank/gated orthogonalization for FT' the paper lists as Future Direction #6.

title: Why Transformers Need Adam: A Hessian Perspective
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Explains why embeddings/heads need adaptive per-block LRs (heavy-tailed spectra) — explains the MION↔Muon embedding gap and why uniform-LR hurts embeddings.

title: Benchmarking Neural Network Training Algorithms (AlgoPerf)
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Methodology for fair, tuned optimizer comparison across workloads — cite to defend the Optuna-per-method protocol and to frame multi-workload claims.

title: SOAP: Improving and Stabilizing Shampoo using Adam
relevance_to_MILO_MION: Baseline in the paper; note its instabilities you observed are known. Whitening view (2509.22938) explains its behavior.
